notes: First containment run (08584077327760454574138334593CU36, 10:21Z) failed at the Teams step: Logic Apps refuses a method on ApiConnectionWebhook inputs. The playbook logged NO DECISION and took no action (fail closed); the template was fixed (method removed) and redeployed before the three runs above.
revokeSignInSessions answered HTTP 200 (Graph v1.0 returns 200 with value true), not 204.

The disable answered 204 with NO directory role on the managed identity: for this non-admin cloud-only user the Graph app roles User.EnableDisableAccount.All + User.Read.All were enough. Admin targets were not tried (never on admins).

All runs were started from the incident (Sentinel incidents/runPlaybook, as the lab operator), not by an automation rule: the automation rules need the Terraform apply of TF_SENTINEL_PLAYBOOK_ID / TF_CONTAINMENT_PLAYBOOK_ID + enable_itdr_containment.
